title: go.mod marks the directly-imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:14 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 // indirect` while store.go:7 imports `_ "modernc.org/sqlite"` directly; `go mod tidy` was not run after adding the import
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency sits in its own require block without the // indirect marker

title: Tests discard json.Unmarshal errors
evidence: main_test.go:41, main_test.go:83, main_test.go:84 call json.Unmarshal without checking the returned error; a non-JSON body would surface only as a confusing zero-value assertion failure
suggestion: Check the error and t.Fatal on a decode failure

title: PUT validation and the year<0 rule are not exercised by any test
evidence: main_test.go:66-76 TestValidation posts only to POST /books; no test sends an invalid body to PUT /books/{id} (main.go:115 shares decode()) or a negative year (main.go:59). Stored test_coverage=0.779 in scores.json
suggestion: Add PUT 400 cases and a negative-year case to TestValidation

title: PUT is a full replace: omitted year/isbn are reset to zero values
evidence: main.go:115-120 decodes a fresh Book and store.go:86 writes all four columns; main_test.go:48 omits isbn on PUT so the stored isbn "123" is silently cleared
suggestion: Acceptable PUT semantics, but document it in README.md or reject bodies missing fields

title: Enhancements beyond spec: 1 MiB body cap, whitespace-trimmed validation, negative-year rejection, env-configurable ADDR/DB_PATH, CGO-free SQLite driver
evidence: main.go:49 http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1<<20); main.go:53 strings.TrimSpace; main.go:59 b.Year < 0; main.go:140-147 DB_PATH/ADDR; store.go:7 modernc.org/sqlite
